name: attempt
notes: SIM counterpart of the hardware 'attempt' gesture, so ARM_FORCE_SIM rehearsals of Agent F's 'told how, now try it' beat play the same beat. NOT taught on hardware. A reach down, a close, a small test lift, a release, and a withdraw — the test lift is what makes it read as an attempt rather than a rehearsed success.

waypoints.label: test lift — did I get it?
